title: Intro to Excel
line: Formulas, lookups, a pivot table and a chart on a monthly budget.

project.title: A bake sale sales report
project.brief: Build a sales report for a bake sale on your own. Look up each item's price with XLOOKUP, work out the money per sale, total it by item and chart the result.
checks: Each sale row gets its price from an XLOOKUP on a price list
A SUMIF or a PivotTable totals sales for each item
A chart of sales by item has a title

lessons.title: Enter a budget in cells and ranges
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner Excel on a Mac. Type a month of spending into a new workbook with headers for item, category, planned and actual in row 1 and twelve rows below, then save budget.xlsx.
lessons.passes: budget.xlsx holds four headers in A1 to D1 and twelve rows below them.

lessons.title: Write your first formulas
lessons.goal: Teach Excel formulas with the equals sign, cell references and the + - * / operators by working out planned minus actual for the first budget item in E2.
lessons.passes: E2 holds a formula that subtracts D2 from C2.

lessons.title: Totals with SUM, AVERAGE and MAX
lessons.goal: Teach Excel functions and ranges with SUM, AVERAGE, MIN and MAX by adding a totals row under the budget and finding the average and the largest amount spent.
lessons.passes: D14 holds a SUM of D2 to D13 and two other cells use AVERAGE and MAX.

lessons.title: Relative and absolute references
lessons.goal: Teach relative and absolute references in Excel. Fill the difference formula down to row 13, then lock the total with $D$14 to work out each item's share of spending.
lessons.passes: F2 to F13 each divide the row's amount by $D$14 and add up to 100 percent.

lessons.title: SUMIF and COUNTIF
lessons.goal: Teach SUMIF and COUNTIF in Excel by building a summary beside the budget that totals the spending and counts the items in each category.
lessons.passes: Each category has a SUMIF and a COUNTIF, and the SUMIF totals add up to D14.

lessons.title: Look things up with XLOOKUP
lessons.goal: Teach XLOOKUP in Excel by pulling each category's monthly limit from a small limits table into the budget rows, with a message for a category that is not found.
lessons.passes: G2 to G13 use XLOOKUP on the limits table with an if not found value set.

lessons.title: Sort and filter
lessons.goal: Teach Sort and Filter in Excel by sorting the budget from the largest amount to the smallest, then filtering it to show only the Food category.
lessons.passes: The rows are sorted by actual, largest first, and a filter shows only Food.

lessons.title: Summarise with a PivotTable
lessons.goal: Teach PivotTables in Excel by summarising the budget on a new sheet, with Category in the rows and the sum of Actual in the values.
lessons.passes: A PivotTable on a new sheet shows the sum of Actual for each category.

lessons.title: Make a chart
lessons.goal: Teach Excel charts by turning the category summary into a column chart with a chart title and axis titles, placed beside the budget.
lessons.passes: A column chart plots the category totals and has a chart title.
